sonnet.problem: Card 4 already asked what happens to the daughters' land if they marry into another tribe, and its right answer was that the land is added to that tribe. Card 6 asks the same fact again for the Jubilee version in verse 4. Verse 4 repeats verse 3's point. The earlier answer also gives away that the land does not go back to the fathers' tribe, so the baker can answer False without reading anything new.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
